name: IEC 62443 Component & System Assessment
description: Covers assessment of industrial automation and control systems and their components against the IEC 62443 series: 62443-3-2 risk assessment and zone/conduit partitioning, 62443-3-3 system security requirements, 62443-4-1 secure development lifecycle and 62443-4-2 component requirements, and the security level (SL-T, SL-C, SL-A) concept. Includes gap analysis, evidence collection and test reporting suitable for certification schemes. Broader OT risk and cyber-physical consequence analysis belongs to ICSIOT-OT-RISK.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the structure of the IEC 62443 series and the security level concept
evidence: Can describe the four IEC 62443 groups (general, policies and procedures, system, component) and the roles of asset owner, integrator and product supplier
Can explain SL-T, SL-C and SL-A and the foundational requirements (FR 1-7)
Knows the difference between a 62443-4-1 process assessment and a 62443-4-2 component assessment

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Contributes to IEC 62443 assessments under supervision
evidence: Maps a component's documented security capabilities to 62443-4-2 requirements and requirement enhancements with guidance
Collects and organises evidence for 62443-4-1 practices (e.g. security requirements, secure design, defect management)
Executes assigned test cases for 62443-3-3 system requirements in a lab environment
Records non-conformities with clear references to the requirement clause

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs IEC 62443 system and component assessments
evidence: Performs a 62443-3-2 zone and conduit risk assessment and derives SL-T per zone
Assesses a system against 62443-3-3 or a component against 62443-4-2 and determines achieved SL-C with supporting test evidence
Assesses a supplier's development process against the 62443-4-1 practices and maturity levels
Produces gap analysis and assessment reports that a certification body can rely on

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Leads complex IEC 62443 assessments; calibrates interpretation; mentors others
evidence: Leads assessments spanning product supplier, integrator and asset owner scope
Resolves ambiguous requirement interpretations and documents lab-wide interpretation decisions
Designs reusable test procedures for 62443-4-2 component requirements across device classes (embedded, host, network, software application)
Reviews and calibrates colleagues' 62443 assessment reports

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's IEC 62443 assessment practice; recognised authority on the standard
evidence: Established the lab's IEC 62443 assessment methodology and its alignment with ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation
Contributes to IEC 62443 standards development, certification scheme rules or published interpretations
Recognised authority consulted on security level determination and conformity disputes
Trains assessors on IEC 62443 system, component and process assessment

assessment_methods.description: Review an IEC 62443-4-2 or 3-3 assessment report for correct requirement mapping, sufficiency of test evidence for each SL-C claim, and traceable non-conformities
Given a system architecture and component datasheets, partition it into zones and conduits, derive SL-T, and identify the 62443-3-3 requirement gaps for one zone
